rules.when: the box is at or over its daily cap, or the live cap table could not be read
this is a test, a duplicate, or a routine question the agent can answer itself
the fix would rotate, regenerate or revoke a credential; change DNS or Cloudflare; delete data or files; or change the client's model or provider
only the client can do it in their own account: sign in again, approve access, add a payment method, top up a balance, confirm a choice
the client's agent cannot act: gateway down, looping, not answering, or the same instruction already failed once on this ticket
the fault is in something we shipped, or the same failure is open on two or more boxes
the fix matches a listed, reversible fix card on a reachable box with a one-line undo
